top_choice_rationale: Cărtărescu's Blinding and Solenoid most compellingly demonstrate a distinctive, sustained visionary architecture in which memory, embodiment and urban space become densely patterned metaphysical fiction. The evidence supports exceptional imaginative and intellectual coherence across the proposed scope, while translation and incomplete coverage of the poetry and wider oeuvre remain material qualifications.
